sn47.7:1.1: atthi bhikkhave himavato pabbatarājassa duggā visamā desā yattha neva makkaṭānaṃ cāri na manussānaṃ.
sn47.7:1.2: atthi bhikkhave himavato pabbatarājassa duggā visamā desā yattha makkaṭānañhi kho cāri na manussānaṃ.
sn47.7:1.3: atthi bhikkhave himavato pabbatarājassa samā bhūmibhāgā ramaṇīyā yattha makkaṭānañceva cāri manussānaṃ ca.
sn47.7:1.4: tatra kho bhikkhave luddhā makkaṭavīthīsu lepaṃ oḍḍenti makkaṭānaṃ bādhanāya.
sn47.7:2.1: tatra bhikkhave ye te makkaṭā abālajātikā alolajātikā te taṃ lepaṃ disvā ārakā parivajjenti.
sn47.7:2.2: yo pana so hoti makkaṭo bālajātiko lolajātiko so taṃ lepaṃ upasaṅkamitvā hatthena gaṇhāti
sn47.7:2.8: ubho hatthe mocessāmi pādaṃ cāti dutiyena pādena gaṇhāti
sn47.7:2.10: ubho hatthe mocessāmi pāde cāti tuṇḍena gaṇhāti
sn47.7:2.12: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave makkaṭo pañcoḍḍito thunaṃ seti anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathā kāmakaraṇīyo luddassa.
sn47.7:2.13: tamenaṃ bhikkhave luddo vijjhitvā tasmiṃ yeva makkaṭaṃ uddharitvā avissajjetvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati.
sn47.7:2.14: evaṃ hetaṃ bhikkhave hoti yo agocare carati paravisaye.
sn47.7:3.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave mā agocare carittha paravisaye.
sn47.7:3.2: agocare bhikkhave carataṃ paravisaye lacchati māro otāraṃ lacchati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn47.7:3.3: ko ca bhikkhave bhikkhuno agocaro paravisayo.
sn47.7:3.7: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn47.7:3.11: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā.
sn47.7:4.1: gocare bhikkhave caratha sake pettike visaye.
sn47.7:4.2: gocare bhikkhave carataṃ sake pettike visaye na lacchati māro otāraṃ na lacchati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn47.7:4.3: ko ca bhikkhave bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayo.
sn47.7:4.7: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.7:4.10: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.7:4.11: ayaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayoti.
